han-dynasty-census.description: An interior of a rustic earthen-walled room. A man in a dark robe and black cap sits at a low wooden table writing with a brush on bamboo slips, with bundles of bound slips and an inkstone beside him. At the open door on the right, a older man, a woman holding a toddler, and a small child stand looking in, with a tiled roof visible outside. Pottery jars and hanging dried herbs fill the background. Oil-painting style, edge to edge.
